remarks: RARE SINGLE-STORY PALACIO PLAN WITH OCEAN/SUNSET VIEWS IN MARINA HILLS! Offering approximately 2,664 square feet, this beautifully appointed Santa Barbara-inspired residence features 3 bedrooms plus an optional den/4th bedroom, an expansive and highly desirable floor plan, 3 Car garage and an impressive 7,200-square-foot lot with rare ocean views.
